rule: SMB Iron condor (5-delta campaign) campaign: 63d, delta 0.05, width 1%, PT 50%
description: SMB SPX iron-condor year [m8R_564Kp6k]: 60-DTE condors with 5-delta short strikes, ~90% per-trade probability, credits ~6-7% of margin, profit-take at 50% of the credit then redeploy - six rolled trades made +39%/yr. Wings 1% wide here (defined risk). Parameters here: 63 trading days, short-leg delta 0.05, width 1%, profit-take 50% (all editable via --smb-dte/--smb-delta/--smb-width-pct/--smb-profit-take-pct). Continuous campaign: a new cycle opens at the close whenever flat. r = cycle P&L / max risk; 1% of equity per cycle.
note: BSM-priced from our quote history; expiry settles intrinsic; NOT modeled: early assignment, dividends, vol smile, intraday management, earnings-date and 0DTE/intraday SMB strategies (need event/intraday data - disclosed out of scope).
